input.question: In a dbt functional test class with multiple test methods that each need to inspect the manifest, what is the correct pattern according to the repository's existing tests?

options.A: The `project` fixture automatically re-runs compilation before each test method, so no explicit `run_dbt(['compile'])` call is needed in individual test methods
options.B: Only the first test method needs to call `run_dbt(['compile'])`; subsequent test methods can rely on the manifest left in the target directory
options.C: A single `run_dbt(['compile'])` call in a `setup_method` or `setup_class` is sufficient for all test methods in the class to share the same manifest
options.D: Each test method that uses manifest data should independently call `run_dbt(['compile'])` at the start of that method before accessing the manifest
